title: Chapter 276: Just a Little More
html:
Being singled out by the Red Specter placed the ruined man under enormous pressure. Before the manic gaze amid that sea of black hair, his own cruelty and madness seemed insignificant. He could feel her hostility fixed upon him.

“Stop her!” The boys sent their blood vessels against Zhang Ya, but the waves of black hair overwhelmed them. They could barely defend themselves.

“Useless!” The ruined man’s face contorted. He lacked the power to confront Zhang Ya himself; his strength came from the Red Specters created from his children’s souls. At their father’s rebuke, the boys screamed. More vessels squeezed from their bloated heads as they threw their bodies into Zhang Ya’s path.

Black hair tore their bodies apart once more. Blood vessels escaped through the strands, but the boys reformed noticeably more slowly.

“No Red Specter should be this powerful. How many Baleful Specters has she consumed?” Disbelief gripped the man. Despite meticulous planning and so many cooperating members, they had failed to kill Chen Ge.

Regret crossed his eyes as the boys were torn apart yet again. His heart bled with them. “We were so close…”

Traps filled both Room 3239 and the apartment opposite. One step into either would have killed Chen Ge before he could summon his ghost. When the boys burst for the fifth time, the scars across the man’s ruined face throbbed. An emotion absent for years returned to his heart—fear.

He clutched his arms, fingers digging into the scars until blood stained them. “What a horrible feeling.”

The wounds split and leaked blood. His composure disintegrated as his grip tightened. “What should I do? What should I do? What should I do?”

The boys exploded, reformed, and rushed forward again. Nothing they attempted could stop Zhang Ya.

She was getting close!

Blood ran from Zhang Ya’s fingers and struck the floor. The ruined man longed to retreat. He glared at Chen Ge behind her.

“I’ll have to sacrifice that.” The man pulled his fingers from the open wound, leaving an arc of blood in the air. From his pocket, he drew a wooden box whose interior bore an inky black bloodstain.

The Baleful Specters wavered on the edge of losing control. The black stain exerted a powerful attraction upon them.

After issuing a silent command, the man seized the box and fled down the corridor, abandoning the boys. Black hair slithered across the floor like snakes, while greed entered Zhang Ya’s eyes—the look of a starving person who had found a feast.

After destroying the boys for the seventh time, Zhang Ya lost patience and sent all her hair after the man. Behind her, vessels from the boys’ remains contracted into droplets of blood. The droplets raced together and gathered, reforming the brothers as a single creature resembling conjoined twins.

“This is bad!” Chen Ge sprinted toward the stairwell. The ruined man had made his final gamble, using himself as bait to create an opportunity to kill Chen Ge.

“We… found you!” The conjoined twins crawled after Chen Ge with astonishing speed. He had badly underestimated them. Zhang Ya’s hair had suppressed the Red Specters so completely that they never displayed their true strength.

Able to dissolve into blood vessels, reform, and move with tremendous speed, the creature would leave Chen Ge no chance of survival in a solitary encounter.

“Xu Yin! Chen Yalin!” Chen Ge summoned every ghost available to buy himself time.

A purple-faced girl and a man whose shirt was half dyed red appeared side by side in the corridor. They blocked the conjoined twins, but to Chen Ge’s despair, the monster barely acknowledged them. Blood-vessel-covered fingers sliced through their bodies like knives.

Xu Yin’s wounds tore open as the blow hurled him into the wall and ripped away one arm. The vessels grievously wounded the Pen Spirit too, leaving her body so faint that she nearly vanished. Neither ghost was the twins’ target. After maiming both Baleful Specters, the creature continued toward Chen Ge without slowing.

No other ghosts would answer his call. Only then did Chen Ge realize how few employees his Haunted House truly possessed. A horrible stench radiated from the conjoined heads as their features shifted. Crooked lips gaped in unrecognizable faces fixed upon him. “We found you!”

A meter away, the twins suddenly slowed and their bulging eyes turned aside. The one-armed Xu Yin had seized the creature’s leg with his remaining hand.

A blood-red hand closed around Xu Yin’s arm. The conjoined twins lifted him and began tearing him in half. His body split down the center, and blood poured from the wound his beloved had left behind. “So painful… so painful!”

Ignoring his half-torn body, Xu Yin bit desperately at the twins. No words could capture the cruelty of a battle between Baleful Specters. Xu Yin could not defeat a Red Specter in his present state; he was sacrificing himself to buy Chen Ge time.

“I need to reach the police!” Chen Ge ran from the corridor. Near the stairwell, a bespectacled man appeared from below. Chen Ge’s heart skipped. It was not an officer but Manager Huang.

“What’s happening? Quickly, follow me!” Manager Huang leaned on the railing, gasping, and extended a hand as though offering safety.

Chen Ge studied the hand and deliberately stepped back.

The night Chen Ge infiltrated the Ghost Stories Society, Manager Huang had been inside Building Three, lecturing Xiao Gu in the lobby. The elevator’s extra button was another clue. The complex manager had to know that no twenty-fourth floor existed, yet he had never removed the number—a simple repair.

Moreover, the Ghost Stories Society gathered at Fang Hwa Apartments without ever appearing on surveillance. Someone within the complex had to be helping them from the shadows.

Seeing Chen Ge’s suspicion, Manager Huang realized the disguise had failed. He slowly turned, revealing the blood face on the back of his head. “I never wanted this, but after joining the society, I became a monster too…”

While Manager Huang lamented his fate, Chen Ge raised Captain Yan’s radio and pressed the transmitter. “Twenty-third floor! All four killers are on the twenty-third floor!”
